user_story: As a user, I want to view sortable data tables on the application so that I can easily read and manage the information presented. The system should display a table with sortable columns including 'Last Name', 'First Name', 'Email', 'Due', 'Web Site', and 'Action'. Acceptance Criteria: The page should have the heading 'Data Tables' displayed as one of the 'headings'. The tables should have IDs 'table1' and 'table2', and the action links should include 'edit' and 'delete' for each row.
